title: VP Exec Playbook — weekly priorities & daily scratchpad
content:
Date range: 2026-03-09 -> 2026-03-12
Context: scratchpad for the week — combine quick decisions, meeting prep, follow-ups I want to dispatch quickly. Not polished — for my brain and rapid forwarding.

WEEKLY TOP 3 (keep on top of these daily)
1) Private GA roadmap — lock compliance checklist + pricing proposal for Q2 launch. Need final legal ok on data residency language.
   - Owner: Maya (follow-up Tuesday)
   - JIRA: DED-1284 (pricing model draft in comments)
2) Dedicated capacity SLOs pilot — ensure minimum sustained throughput and transparent billing metrics in Console.
   - Critical to close with 2 pilot customers this quarter
   - Ask infra: two-week test schedule and expected telemetry samples
3) Improve median p50 latency for 8k token traces on A30 racks by 8–10% via kernel tuning + dynamic batching.
   - PR 542 references a batching improvement we can cherry-pick for Dedicated.

TODAY (2026-03-12) TIMEBLOCKS
- 08:30–09:00: Deep review — Private GA compliance doc (Maya) — annotate live
- 09:15–09:45: 1:1 with Product Ops (Ben) — gating items for pricing rollout
- 10:30–11:15: Customer call (Pilot #2) — confirm SLA terms and data pathway
- 12:00–12:30: Lunch / quick notes catch-up
- 13:00–14:00: Tandem with Platform Eng — review canary rollback policy and console UX for route-level metrics
- 15:00–15:30: Exec sync (brief): highlight risks and ask for resources
- 17:00–17:30: Buffer / follow-up send-off

MEETING PREP (bullet notes I want handy)
- Private GA doc: key open Qs to surface to Legal
   * Explicit: KMS integrations + key rotation SLA wording (customer-facing)
   * Air-gapped install support window and scope (what we commit to vs professional services)
- Pilot SLA conversation: show 30-day rollout plan, fallback routes to hosted if capacity breach >2%
- Canary rollback policy: ensure console shows per-model error rate + auto-fallback threshold decision (default 5% error spike)

QUICK FOLLOW-UPS / EMAILS TO SEND (one-liners)
- To Maya: "Thanks — flagged the KMS paragraph; can you add recommended attr list by EOD? I'll review at 08:30."
- To Ben: "Please attach the sample billing CSV for Dedicated pilots before our 9:15; we need a line-item for burst capacity."
- To Platform Eng lead (cc SRE): "Can you confirm the expected percent improvement from PR 542 and if any perf regressions are expected on 4k traces?"

DECISIONS NEEDED (bold)
- Do we ship Private GA with optional on-prem packaging (extra fee) or delay packaging for 1 month to harden installer? (Trade: revenue vs support risk)
- Do we bake in a soft limit for cross-region routing in first pilot? (Cost control vs latency)

BLOCKERS / RISKS
- Legal note on data residency: uses "logical region" wording that customers will challenge. Need stronger text.
- Engineering: mem overhead regression in nightly tests after quantization change — devs flagged an unknown baseline shift. Ticket created.
- Sales: one pilot customer requested a 99.99% uptime SLA — need to evaluate capacity and on-call costs.

NOTES TO SELF (brain dump)
- Keep the weekly status note < 5 bullets for Board update — focus on traction (pilot customers), operational readiness (runbooks), and cost/perf wins.
- Ask Growth to prepare 2 short case studies from the beta customers (anonymized) for next stakeholder email.
- Revisit pricing floor for Dedicated: ensure margin at 40% on expected utilization (calc in sheet linked).

MINI CHECKLIST (tick when done)
[ ] Finalize KMS language with Legal
[ ] Confirm Dedicated billing CSV sample
[ ] Get Platform Eng perf estimate for PR 542
[ ] Draft 5-line status for Board (due Friday)

SNIPPET: one-paragraph summary to paste into slack/exec email
"Quick update: moving Private towards GA this month — legal has one outstanding KMS/data residency point, engineering is running a small kernel/batching improvement (PR 542) that should shave p50 by ~8%, and Dedicated pilots are on track pending final pilot billing CSV. Need approval on whether to include on-prem packaging in first GA. Details in the doc linked above. — EK"

RANDOM IDEAS / MITIGATION NOTES
- Consider temporary feature flag for cross-region routing to cap cost exposure while we observe traffic patterns.
- For installer: supply a managed-by-Redwood option for first 30 customers to reduce support load. Charge setup fee.

TODAY FOLLOW-UP ACTIONS (after 17:00)
- Send the 3 one-liner emails above
- Update the Board status draft (5 lines) and push to the board folder
- Ping infra for perf numbers and ask for a short email thread so I can forward to Sales

END OF SCRATCHPAD — will prune and convert to polished notes for Friday exec summary.
